 -- Converts GMT date to local date (IM# 5320)

 l_local_time := to_char(v_local_time, 'MM-DD-YYYY');
 else

 end if;
 --

if :valid_resources.eff_date < to_date(l_local_time, 'MM-DD-YYYY') then

end if; 
if :valid_resources.term_date is not null then

end if ;

 :valid_resources.resource_code is null 
THEN

 begin
 loop
 set_item_property(temp_item,ITEM_IS_VALID, property_true);
 temp_item := get_item_property(temp_item, nextitem);
 exit when temp_item is null;
 temp_item := 'VALID_RESOURCES.'||temp_item;
 end loop;
 end;
END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM1
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM1(p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;
